challenge_description.name: A Crate Wide Open
challenge_description.all_names: A Crate Wide Open, A Create Idea
challenge_description.description: The tribes will race through an intersecting obstacle and untie five bags of balls. They will then work together to get one person high enough to push those balls into a chute, releasing a key. They will then use the key to unlock six very heavy wooden crates. They will push those crates under a heavy cargo net. They will bring it to the end, where they will build a staircase. They will then climb to the top, where two players will race to solve a Survivor logo puzzle.

challenge_description.name: Five Blind Mice
challenge_description.description: Tied in pairs with one player blind folded, tribes run up a cargo net teeter totter, climb through a cargo net, untie sandbags from a robe wrapped around a log, build a long pole and balance a sandbag on the pole and hook the sandbags on three hoods. First tribe to finish wins.

challenge_description.name: Hartford Whalers
challenge_description.description: Tribes drag a large 500-pound whale through the water, over a log that rotates, all players must make it over the log as well, onto the beach, release a ball from a net and roll the ball into a hole on a table. The first tribe to do this three times wins immunity.
